subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should the public after-compaction hook contract expose only `resetSession(reason?)`, or permanently support the explicit-session-key compatibility overload used by an unmerged external fork?
rationale: The explicit-key overload is a new compatibility promise on a plugin API, but repository policy rejects runtime compatibility for contracts that never shipped; only the compaction/plugin owner can decide whether the deployed external usage warrants an exception.

options.title: Current-session API only
options.body: Remove the explicit-key overload and require plugins to update to `resetSession("new" | "reset")`, preserving the narrow safety boundary.

options.title: Temporary compatibility overload
options.body: Keep the explicit-key form only with explicit deprecation documentation, compatibility tests, and a named removal release.

options.title: Defer the API
options.body: Pause this PR until the broader plugin session-lifecycle contract is designed and approved.

recommendation.title: Current-session API only
recommendation.body: Remove the explicit-key overload and require plugins to update to `resetSession("new" | "reset")`, preserving the narrow safety boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the compaction and context-engine lifecycle boundary identified as Josh Lehman's ownership area.
